description.narrative: "NSS is a network of rural women's organizations from seven West African countries (Burkina Faso, Mali, Ghana, Guinea and Senegal, Gambia and Guinea Bissau) created to promote the voice of peasants in agricultural governance at the local, national and continental levels.Its mission is to strengthen the capacities of rural women; influence agricultural governance towards food sovereignty; and fight for the rights of access of rural women and girls to land and other means of production.The Equality Fund grant will be used to finance operational expenses including part of operating costs. This grant also supports:- The organization of annual meetings- NSS being a young movement needs regular meetings of leaders, in order to exchange good practices, resolve difficulties together and strengthen the movement in its maturation and scaling phase.- The annual meeting helps to strengthen the capacities of AFR leaders in one of the themes chosen by the Board of Directors- The massification of the movement at the country level following to the numerous requests for membership from rural women's associations active in agriculture, livestock breeding and the processing of local products."
